_readme: Hand decisions for 04-new-trails.mjs, keyed by OSM relation id. reject = leave the candidate out (reason shown in the report); keep = accept even if it overlaps a catalogue trail.

19470233.reject: the OSM mapper notes (fixme) that the route was copied from a map sign and has not been checked on the ground

20296500.reject: the relation lists its ways twice: the stitched line is 4.1 km out and back while its own distance tag says 2 km
